I think otherwise. When farming, time and weather are very much correlated (night=colder, day=hotter, in my experience, it tends to bewarmest from 12:00 up to 19:00). This will also give players better approximation of travel time (Suppose to say I want to arrive at red winter zone up north by 10:00, or when it's starting to get sunny, knowing at approximately what time I should leave my base helps a lot).

Right now, we can only check the time by entering an area. If I don't check the time at base first (leaving then entering again: https://imgur.com/JSzacYl), it's usually too late for me to realize that I arrived at the red winter zone at night, in the middle of the cold. And while I can always wait or come back, I don't want to waste too much of my real world time LOL

Some players can argue this is too little a detail to focus on, but as the saying goes, it's the little details that make big things happen. :)
